Editing a Spec by Hand vs Letting Kiro Redraft It

Should you ever hand-edit a Kiro spec? Yes — here's when.
Hand-edit for small wording fixes or precise acceptance criteria.
Let Kiro redraft when the whole approach needs to change.
Mixing both is normal — just re-sync after big manual edits.
